title: royascaff adapter: data
description: The `data` of the contract envelope for `adapter`. `adapter new <name>` returns the files it made; `adapter test <name>` returns every check with its result (a failed test is an envelope failure with code CHECK_FAILED; the same data is in error.details). The manifest itself is described by adapter.schema.json. Extra fields are allowed: adding a field is a minor change.
